sut.name: trainticket
sut.deploy: kind cluster 'mist', ns trainticket; ts-contacts-service is UPSTREAM base codewisdom/ts-contacts-service:1.0.0 (image_digest pins the deployed base). No fault injected; the trigger is a duplicate create.

config.note: No fault injected. The trigger is a DUPLICATE create: POST the same contact (same accountId + documentNumber business key) twice; the unmodified SUT's dedupe path soft-rejects the second create with status:0.

stimulus.workload_variant: duplicate-create (identical accountId+documentNumber; second call is the case)

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Designed duplicate-rejection, not a lost write: the second create returns HTTP 2xx with a TrainTicket envelope carrying status:0 ('Contacts already exists') and by design persists nothing new. The surface phenomenon matches accept-then-drop (2xx + no count delta on read-back), which is why this is the canonical benign trap for the acknowledged-lost-write class on this SUT - but the response body explicitly signals non-acceptance (status:0), so a correct acknowledgement rule must exclude it. Grounded in the Gate-1 G0 evidence (prep/sut-fault-injection-capability.md section 9; PairedFaultExecutor ACCEPT_THEN_DROP_DISCLOSURE: TrainTicket's only by-design drop soft-rejects with status:0).

provenance.notes: Live-captured: second identical POST returns 2xx {0,"Contacts already exists"}; no new membership row (count delta zero). Stratum-2 benign trap for the ACK rule specifically: mist_readback must NOT fire because MIST's acknowledgement predicate (2xx AND body status in {null,1}) EXCLUDES the status:0 soft-reject, so the base relation is vacuous (a true negative, not a lucky miss). body_marker_oracle FLAGS the status:0 marker and is therefore WRONG on this benign case (intended business behavior) - that gap is the discriminating value. rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): fault_class stays acknowledged_lost_write (benign-trap convention = tag the class the trap is FOR, matching bookinfo-ratings-benign=swallowed_downstream_error; 'none' is reserved for clean controls); ack_content_visibility=status-field-tells (drives body_marker=flag). REVIEW-CORPUS R2 (as-deployed evaluability): trace-uninstrumented deploy → naive_span_error/tracetest_presence/mist_trace_shape = not_applicable (tracetest_presence also n/a for a second reason: single-service in-process persistence, no cross-service dependency span). mist_readback=no_flag is a real as-deployed true-negative (the read-back ran; MIST's ack predicate excludes status:0). Documents the disclosed limitation that TrainTicket has NO 2xx-success-body-but-never-persists representative (its only by-design drop signals status:0). R16: the linked sidecar's internal case_id is 'tt-s2-contacts-dedupe' (alias of this case; file-path link is correct; the captured artifact is not rewritten post-hoc).
